answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 15759 Country: India Title: Assalam-O-Alaikum, Mufti saab, please advice how to calculate zakat of gold, is it based on purchased value or prsent market value. Can we give zakat to our close relative who is need of money to pay for his work visa & ticket Jazak Allah Khair Question: Assalam-O-Alaikum, Mufti saab, please advice how to calculate zakat of gold, is it based on purchased value or prsent market value. Can we give zakat to our close relative who is need of money to pay for his work visa & ticket Jazak Allah Khair Answer ID: 15759 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1419/1419=M=1430) The Zakah will be calculated as per the extant market rate. (2) You can give Zakah to a close relative if he deserves to receive Zakah. But, you should explain what type of relationship he had with you (as giving Zakah to some relatives is not allowed). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
